# entrepot_signing_key (Data Source)

The public signing key of a hosted `apt` or `yum` repository, e.g. to install it on hosts (`/etc/apt/keyrings/…`, `rpm --import`). The server generates a key the first time one is needed, so reading this data source may create it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Distribute a repository's public key to hosts, e.g. with cloud-init.
data "entrepot_signing_key" "apt" {
  repository = "apt-internal"
}

locals {
  cloud_init_apt = {
    apt = {
      sources = {
        entrepot = {
          source = "deb [signed-by=$KEY_FILE] https://entrepot.example.com/repository/apt-internal/ stable main"
          key    = data.entrepot_signing_key.apt.public_key
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

output "apt_key_url" {
  value = data.entrepot_signing_key.apt.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository` (String) Name of a hosted `apt` or `yum` repository.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) Key algorithm, e.g. `rsa4096` or `ed25519`.
- `created_at` (String) When the active key was imported or generated (RFC 3339).
- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint (upper-case hex) of the active key.
- `id` (String) Same as `repository`.
- `public_key` (String) ASCII-armored OpenPGP public key.
- `url` (String) URL from which clients download the public key.
